identity.tagline: Bread the slow way, every morning
identity.voice: Warm, floury, plain-spoken; a baker talking, never a brand talking.

art_direction: Warm stoneground neutrals under a deep rye brown, with one ember-orange accent used sparingly like a heat lamp. Generous whitespace, oversized serif headlines, photography that looks flour-dusted rather than staged.

sections.copy_notes: Full-bleed statement: the bakery name, the tagline, and one line about the 36-hour sourdough process. Single call-to-action button down to the signup section.
sections.image_intent: A rustic sourdough loaf on a floured oak counter, dawn light from a side window, steam rising, no people.

design.notes: Dawn light; the loaf is the hero image.

sections.copy_notes: Three columns: Sourdough (the daily loaf), Pastry (morning croissants and cardamom knots), Rye & Seed (the dense Nordic loaves). One honest sentence each, no superlatives.
sections.image_intent: A trio of breads arranged on a linen cloth seen from above: a boule, two croissants, a dark seeded rye, muted warm tones.

sections.copy_notes: Newsletter signup: one line promising the weekly bake list and nothing else, an email field, and a quiet reassurance that unsubscribing is one click.

design.notes: The one bright moment on the page.

custom_blocks.title: Signup Banner
custom_blocks.description: An email signup banner that submits to the bakery newsletter list.
custom_blocks.gap_argument: Core vocabulary has no block that renders a form posting to a custom REST route: supports and tokens style existing blocks but cannot add a submit lane, no registered block style or variation of core/buttons produces an email field, and the form must POST with a nonce to the newsletter package route — behavior, not styling, so rungs 1-4 cannot express it.
custom_blocks.render_intent: Render a single-field email signup form: label, email input, submit button, honeypot field, nonce; POST via view.js fetch to the newsletter package subscribe route and swap in a thank-you line on success.

schema_packages.intent: Store newsletter subscribers submitted from the public signup form.
schema_packages.lifecycle_argument: Subscribers are records with a lifecycle the block cannot own: created anonymously from the front end, held in a moderated pending state, listed and exported by staff in wp-admin, and cleanly removed on uninstall — storage with statuses and an admin surface, which is wp-schema territory, never render.php state.

routes.intent: Accept an email address, validate it server-side, create a pending subscriber.

footer.intent: One quiet line: the bakery name, opening hours, and the street address; a link back home.
